subject.title: Skills silently truncated - user-created skills invisible with no warning or prioritization

question: Should OpenClaw handle skills prompt overflow with the narrow omitted-key visibility fix, a new priority/pinning configuration surface, broader smart/lazy skill indexing, or a staged combination?
rationale: Current main proves the truncation behavior is real, but the remaining solutions affect prompt policy and config/API shape rather than a single strict bug fix.

options.title: Stage Visibility First
options.body: Review the open omitted-key PR first, then decide priority or smart loading separately in the existing product issues.

options.title: Prioritize Config Pinning
options.body: Design a small core config surface for pinned or high-priority skills before landing prompt-format changes that may become temporary.

options.title: Move To Smart Loading
options.body: Treat the issue as part of a larger skill indexing/lazy-loading redesign and avoid incremental prompt-list changes except urgent visibility fixes.

recommendation.title: Stage Visibility First
recommendation.body: Review the open omitted-key PR first, then decide priority or smart loading separately in the existing product issues.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has recent skills documentation/prompt-limit history and is a reasonable route for deciding whether the current docs/config shape should expand.
